comments.text: Cambodia is interesting because low prices for visitors do not necessarily mean life feels cheap for local families. 🇰🇭💵 The real comparison only makes sense when rent, food and services are measured against local wages rather than foreign income. That gap between what tourists experience and what residents can actually afford is often the most revealing part of understanding everyday life.
